Definition: properly, to gape, i.e. snap at; figuratively, to overwhelm
BiblicalUsage: Shuph means to bruise, to snap at, to overwhelm, and its first occurrence is the promise itself: the seed of the woman shall bruise the serpent's head, and the serpent shall bruise his heel. Job feels it as a tempest breaking him, and the psalmist says if the darkness should cover him, even the night would be light about him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the first bruise is also the first promise. The serpent's head is bruised by the very heel it struck, and I hold that the wound of the cross is the wound that healed the world.
